reasoning_steps.description: Your reasoning as short steps that each name the memory item you used, e.g. 'e2 gives the completion year 2011'.

grounded.description: True ONLY when your answer is stated by the memory items in this prompt. Never true from your own training knowledge.

answer.description: Answer the exact question asked, in one or two sentences, using the memory items' own wording. When nothing supports an answer, say you don't know.

used_evidence_ids.description: The ids (e1, e2, ...) of the memory items your answer came from. Empty when not grounded.

evidence.description: Verbatim quotes copied from those memory items. Empty when not grounded.

needs_more_context.description: True when the retrieved items are related but do not contain what the question asks, so more memory should be fetched before answering.

follow_up_lookups.description: What to retrieve next when needs_more_context is true: name the subject or the term the memory should be searched for.

open_question.description: Set has_question true whenever grounded is false, so the gap gets recorded instead of guessed.
